entries.title: Psalms 23:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD [is] my shepherd; I shall not want.

entries.title: Psalms 23:2
segments: He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters.

entries.title: Psalms 23:3
segments: He restores my soul; He leads me in the paths of righteousness For His name's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 23:4
segments: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You [are] with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

entries.title: Psalms 23:5
segments: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.

entries.title: Psalms 23:6
segments: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the LORD Forever.
